examples.text: The passage is most probably taken from a review of a sports event.
examples.translation: 这篇文章最有可能是选自一篇体育赛事的评论。
examples.speechText: The passage is most probably taken from a review of a sports event.

examples.text: You can usually get a healthy, cheap breakfast in a restaurant.
examples.translation: 你通常能在餐馆里吃到健康又便宜的早餐。
examples.speechText: You can usually get a healthy, cheap breakfast in a restaurant.

examples.text: Cash was the best way to teach people about financial knowledge because it's so easy to grasp.
examples.translation: 过去，用现金是传授金融知识的最佳方式，因为它十分直观易懂。
examples.speechText: Cash was the best way to teach people about financial knowledge because it's so easy to grasp.

examples.text: The editor asked his journalists not to leave out any details in their reports of the accident.
examples.translation: 编辑要求记者报道这起事故时，不要遗漏任何细节。
examples.speechText: The editor asked his journalists not to leave out any details in their reports of the accident.

examples.text: Honest communication matters more than perfection.
examples.translation: 坦诚沟通比事事完美更重要。
examples.speechText: Honest communication matters more than perfection.

examples.text: When I was young, I wasn’t used to being criticized（criticize的过去分词形式） when I made some mistakes.
examples.translation: 小时候，我犯错时还不习惯受到批评。
examples.speechText: When I was young, I wasn’t used to being criticized when I made some mistakes.

examples.text: The simplest solution is the use of programs which block offensive sites.
examples.translation: 最简单的解决办法，是使用能够屏蔽不良网站的程序。
examples.speechText: The simplest solution is the use of programs which block offensive sites.

examples.text: With the move towards a cashless society, pocket money is moving digital.
examples.translation: 随着社会走向无现金化，零花钱也在走向数字化。
examples.speechText: With the move towards a cashless society, pocket money is moving digital.

examples.text: Things have changed（change的过去分词形式） greatly since then.

examples.speechText: Things have changed greatly since then.

examples.text: Weiqi can teach concentration, balance and discipline.
examples.translation: 围棋能培养专注力、平衡意识和自律能力。
examples.speechText: Weiqi can teach concentration, balance and discipline.

examples.text: I wish to talk it over with you.

examples.text: While babies hold toys（toy的复数形式） to feel safe when their mothers are not there, adults collect things to stop feeling lonely or anxious.
examples.translation: 婴儿在妈妈不在身边时，会抱着玩具来获得安全感；成年人则通过收藏物品，摆脱孤独或焦虑。
examples.speechText: While babies hold toys to feel safe when their mothers are not there, adults collect things to stop feeling lonely or anxious.

examples.text: Just keeping away can help traffic flow smoothly.
examples.translation: 只要保持车距，就有助于车流顺畅通行。
examples.speechText: Just keeping away can help traffic flow smoothly.
